item_no.label: Budget Account Code (account)
item_no.why: Every one of the 30 settlements (own and colleague, all pots) uses account 410201 Domestic Business Travel.

daily_fee_total.label: Daily Expense - Total Budget
daily_fee_total.why: Prefilled from the request. Corpus rate: 20,000 per day in Seoul/Gyeonggi (Seoul 0n1d=20,000, 0n2d=40,000, 2n3d=60,000; Goyang request 30,000 was settled at 20,000 in 292982) and 30,000 per day elsewhere (Cheongju, Daejeon, Gyeongju).

daily_fee_card.label: Daily Expense - Institute Credit Card
daily_fee_card.why: The daily allowance is always paid to the traveller (Cash/Personal column), never on the institute card: 30/30 docs show 0 here.

daily_fee_cash.label: Daily Expense - Cash / Personal Credit Card
daily_fee_cash.why: Equals the settled allowance for this trip (rate in daily_fee_total).

daily_fee_sum.label: Daily Expense - Sum
daily_fee_sum.why: Settled allowance; Finance lowers it where the request overstated the rate (292982).

daily_fee_diff.label: Daily Expense - Differences
daily_fee_diff.why: Total Budget minus Sum, computed by the form.

transport_fee_total.label: Transport Fee - Total Budget
transport_fee_total.why: Actual transport cost; own-car trips claim fuel (and toll) in the Cash/Personal column, public-transport day trips in Seoul claim 0 (all 7 RAPID/Seoul public-transport settlements are 0).

accommodation_fee_total.label: Accommodation - Total Budget
accommodation_fee_total.why: Hotel paid on the institute card goes in the Credit Card column (284346, 295935, 295950); paid personally goes in Cash with a 'reason for not using R&D card' statement attached (296047, 296103).

food_fee_total.label: Food Expense - Total Budget
food_fee_total.why: Prefilled from the request; outside Seoul/Gyeonggi 9,000 per meal (27,000/day, 81,000 for 3 days) less meals provided ('Number of meals served'), and 0 for Seoul.

food_fee_card.label: Food Expense - Institute Credit Card
food_fee_card.why: The food allowance is a per-meal allowance paid to the traveller: 30/30 docs show 0 in the card column.

food_fee_sum.label: Food Expense - Sum
food_fee_sum.why: Settled food allowance; see the conditional for Seoul.

settle_amount.label: Total Sum - Sum
settle_amount.why: Total settled amount, the sum of the rows.

note.label: Note(s)
note.why: Left empty in 30/30 docs; the per-row Description cell is used instead when a remark is needed (e.g. 'Appr No' for a card payment in 295935).

purpose_category.label: Purpose of Business Travel
purpose_category.why: Inherited from the request (AppFrm-023 rulebook governs it); corpus: sampling and meetings = 'Simple visit to vendor & etc', conferences = 'Participation in the conference/seminar'.

purpose.label: Purpose
purpose.why: Inherited from the request, not editable here; English-only and length rules belong to the AppFrm-023 rulebook.

travel_with_invitation.label: Travel with Invitation
travel_with_invitation.why: Inherited from the request; 'No' in all 30 docs.

attach_row:verification.label: Business trip verification documents (date,location, details) [travel_doc_e]
attach_row:verification.why: The proof that the trip happened as approved goes here: the invitation/request email printed from Gmail, the official letter (공문), the registration confirmation or name badge; 17/20 colleague settlements put it in this row (exceptions: 297516 Boarding Pass, 299243 and 300165 ETC), while the user put it in ETC in 3 of 10 (286840, 286841, 295629), which org practice says is the wrong row.

attach_row:transport.label: Transport [travel_doc_a]
attach_row:transport.why: Only when a transport cost is claimed: train/bus receipts (284346), own-car route/distance printout (296047 travel.pdf, 296103 travel_HK.pdf) and Hi-Pass toll records (295950); empty for 0-cost public-transport day trips.

attach_row:accommodation.label: Accommodation [travel_doc_b]
attach_row:accommodation.why: Only when accommodation is claimed: the booking confirmation plus the receipt or corporate-card sales slip (매출전표), and, if paid personally, the 'Statement / Reason for not using R&D card' (296047, 296103).

attach_row:boarding_pass.label: Boarding Pass (Certificate of Entry&Departure) [travel_doc_c]
attach_row:boarding_pass.why: Not used for domestic trips: empty in 29/30 docs (the one exception, 297516, is a misplaced meeting flyer).

attach_row:etc.label: ETC (Visa, Insurance etc) [travel_doc_d]
attach_row:etc.why: Normally empty; at most a secondary item such as a payment/registration confirmation (299243, own 292982) - the main trip evidence belongs in the verification row, not here.

attach_row:poster.label: Poster [travel_doc_f]
attach_row:poster.why: Conference trips only: the event poster or the traveller's poster (299233, 299243, 299491, own 295935); empty for meetings and sampling.

attach_row:file_attachment.label: File Attachment List / Additional document & Transfer Receipt
attach_row:file_attachment.why: The generic list is empty in 30/30 settlements; 'Additional document & Transfer Receipt' holds Finance's transfer receipt (<budget control no>.pdf), so the traveller adds evidence to the typed rows instead (own 284346 put card slips here, an exception).

sel_travel.label: Attach Approved Document
sel_travel.why: The approved AppFrm-023 request this settlement is opened from (p_doc_id).

conditional.why: No food allowance is paid for Seoul trips: all 17 Seoul settlements (12 colleague, 5 own; day trips and 2-night stays alike) settle food at 0, whereas every non-metro trip gets 9,000 per meal.
